batch.topic: A measured increase in concentration can follow a decrease in volume even when the amount of solute is unchanged; preserve quantities and qualification.
A comparison averages performance across source groups rather than across all individual observations; unequal group sizes matter.
A list is sorted using a stable algorithm, so equal keys retain their previous relative order; stability is not a claim about execution time.
A model is evaluated with a fixed random seed but results on another dataset are not thereby guaranteed to match; reproducibility has a specified scope.
